2610.11344.title: EvoSim: Learning to Model, Modeling to Learn
2610.11344.paper_summary: Physics-based models connect scientific explanation with quantitative prediction. Constructing them requires selecting physical processes, defining states and governing equations, specifying couplings, and identifying parameters from experiments. Existing AI systems remain limited in making these model structure decisions autonomously. We introduce EvoSim, a self-evolving AI scientist for physical modeling. It uses experimental discrepancies to drive mechanism and equation revisions and held-out experimental data to test physical plausibility. Exploration traces make updates to knowledge, skills, and multi-agent orchestration. This co-evolution improves physics-based models and EvoSim's ability to select mechanisms, diagnose failures, and coordinate research. We evaluate EvoSim on two industrial battery modeling tasks. It predicts lithium-metal-plating onset from 25 to 45 degrees Celsius and 2 C to 6 C with a mean absolute error of 1.79% in state of charge. Dynamic voltage prediction under vehicle driving conditions achieves a root mean square error of 7.62 mV, surpassing the reported accuracy of models developed by human experts. Self-evolution reduces model and physics errors by approximately 36% relative to baseline, demonstrating improved scientific modeling capability. EvoSim turns experimental observations into validated models and cumulative research expertise.
2610.11344.paper_summary_zh: 物理基礎模型將科學解釋與定量預測聯繫起來。構建這些模型需要選擇物理過程、定義狀態和控制方程、指定耦合以及從實驗中識別參數。現有的人工智慧系統在自主做出這些模型結構決策方面仍然有限。我們介紹了EvoSim，一個自我演化的人工智慧科學家，用於物理建模。它利用實驗差異來驅動機制和方程的修訂，並使用保留的實驗數據來測試物理的合理性。探索痕跡對知識、技能和多代理協調進行更新。這種共同演化改善了基於物理的模型以及EvoSim在選擇機制、診斷故障和協調研究方面的能力。我們在兩個工業電池建模任務上評估了EvoSim。它預測鋰金屬鍍層的開始溫度範圍為25到45攝氏度，電流密度為2 C到6 C，充電狀態的平均絕對誤差為1.79%。在車輛行駛條件下的動態電壓預測達到了7.62 mV的均方根誤差，超過了人類專家開發的模型報告的準確性。自我演化使模型和物理誤差相對於基準減少了約36%，顯示出改善的科學建模能力。EvoSim將實驗觀察轉化為經過驗證的模型和累積的研究專業知識。
